intent: Group several key caps into one chorded shortcut so they read as pressed together.
typical_uses: A chord at the end of a menu item or tooltip (Ctrl + K opens the palette)
A shortcut hint under an empty state (Space to preview)

dont_use_when.situation: A single key with nothing to group
Keys listed as alternatives or in a legend rather than pressed together

instead.target: separate Kbd elements, each placed in the surrounding text

invariants.text: KbdGroup separates its children with a fixed visual gap and nothing else - there is no separator glyph and no prop to add one.

anti_patterns.dont: Put plain text keys inside a group expecting spacing between them
anti_patterns.do_instead: Give each key its own Kbd - the gap applies between the Kbd elements, while contiguous text collapses into one unspaced run

bad.title: A separator prop guessed from an older library version
bad.why: KbdGroup takes no kit-specific props; the visual gap is fixed styling and there is no separator prop - every prop here is the native kbd element's.

bad.title: One key alone
bad.why: A group exists to space several keys apart; a single key is what Kbd itself renders, and the group carries none of the key-cap styling on its own.
